 def mark_client_gone(request: web.Request) -> None:
     request[_CLIENT_GONE] = True
 
+# LOGROTATE-01: one INFO line per request filled the launchd stderr log
+# (~480 MB). Lines the BENCHSEV/LOOPLAG and client_gone analyses read stay at
+# INFO; every other healthy request is sampled 1-in-N at INFO, the rest DEBUG.
+SLOW_REQUEST_MS = 1000.0
+LAGGED_ENTRY_MS = 250.0
+HEALTHY_SAMPLE_EVERY = 100
+_healthy_requests = itertools.count()
+
+
+def completion_level(
+    elapsed_ms: float,
+    status: int | None,
+    client_gone: bool | None,
+    entry_lag_ms: float | None,
+    *,
+    aborted: bool = False,
+) -> int:
+    """INFO for slow, failed, non-2xx, aborted or loop-lagged requests."""
+    if (
+        aborted
+        or elapsed_ms > SLOW_REQUEST_MS
+        or status is None
+        or not 200 <= status < 300
+        or client_gone is not False
+        or (entry_lag_ms is not None and entry_lag_ms >= LAGGED_ENTRY_MS)
+    ):
+        return logging.INFO
+    if next(_healthy_requests) % HEALTHY_SAMPLE_EVERY == 0:
+        return logging.INFO
+    return logging.DEBUG
+
 
 def _report_loop_lag(samples: list[float]) -> None:
